$comment: Stage target for bun run release:run (D61 rule 2): the same steps as prod.json, against the stage target database that scripts/release/stage-target.ts up restores before the run. HOME is a dedicated directory whose .env names that database. The legacy stack is the v0.5.4 checkout booted against it (PR 1229). watchMinAttendance is 0.4 on stage: the four external members file against production, never against the stage database, so a stage session holds at most the three in-house takes of seven active members (3/7 = 0.43). Production keeps the gate's default 0.5 (owner-visible, 2026-10-08).
